caption:
They say in the Undergrid, you don't just trade data—you trade sensations. ⚡️

Tonight, the air in the 'Neural Nest' is thick with the scent of ozone and expensive synthetic spice. I’m leaning against a cold chrome pillar, my body humming with the residual static of the last hack. The bodysuit I’m wearing—a custom piece of tech-silk that hugs every curve—feels like a second skin, pulsing in sync with the flickering neon signs outside. 

I can feel his eyes on me from across the room. He’s a high-tier broker, and he wants a piece of the memory I just pulled from the mainframe. It’s a forbidden sequence: the feeling of falling in love, distilled into a digital stream. I lean closer to him, the heat radiating between us. My pulse quickens, a frantic rhythm against my ribs. I whisper into his ear, the heat of my breath hitting his skin, and tell him the price isn't just credits. It's an experience. 

He reaches out, his fingers grazing my waist, and for a second, the world blurs into a haze of violet and gold. The connection is electric. It’s dangerous, it’s illicit, and it’s the only thing that makes me feel alive in this suffocating, metallic city. Do you want to see what happens when we sync? 💋
